title: MCP tools return model-facing views, not engine records
trigger: When adding fields to retrieve results or atoms, or changing what MCP retrieve/get return
behavior_delta: Keep engine bookkeeping out of MCP output. retrieve returns only {abstained, memories[id, memory_type, content, lifecycle_state?, contested?, contradicts?]}; get returns the atom without retrieval_forms, what, evidence_state, project_id, registry_key_id, schema_version, activation_count, with each evidence_ref annotated by its verification status only. The raw atom is behind get verbose=true. Add new engine fields to HIT_FIELDS/ENGINE_FIELDS in src/mcp/tools.js deliberately, not by default.
what: Keep engine bookkeeping out of MCP output. retrieve returns only {abstained, memories[id, memory_type, content, lifecycle_state?, contested?, contradicts?]}; get returns the atom without retrieval_forms, what, evidence_state, project_id, registry_key_id, schema_version, activation_count, with each evidence_ref annotated by its verification status only. The raw atom is behind get verbose=true. Add new engine fields to HIT_FIELDS/ENGINE_FIELDS in src/mcp/tools.js deliberately, not by default.
why: Measured 2026-09-22: ~4.2 KB of the ~7 KB get payload was exact duplication of authored text plus evidence hashes. The compact view cut get by 60.9% (7158 to 2796 B avg over 35 active atoms) with no authored content removed. Budget accounting stays in the engine, so the stripped view is always within the budget the engine enforced.
trigger_variants: Add a field to what retrieve returns
Agregar un campo a lo que devuelve retrieve
